ms.promise:
3.1 Builder Phase and prize distribution
・Judging is only done after the 1-month-long builder phase which follows the kick-off weekend (from milestone 2). This allows the builders time to refine and get feedback on their product before a final submission is made in May. The judges, possibly in conjunction with the Cardano community, evaluate the final submission in May and check for cheating (i.e. taking an old project). 
・One potential way we might do this is to have the judges select 5 projects who will be finalists, and then there will be more community-based voting to determine the rank-order amongst these 5 projects! 
・$8,000 worth of ADA will be split between the top 5 projects. The exact amount is to be determined, but the higher placed projects should be commensurately rewarded!

ms.report:
Project Close-out Report: Cardano x African Blockchain Championship 
Original submission: August 19th, 2025
Revision 1: August 24th, 2025. Changes: (a) Opened Google Docs version URL access for public view, (b) Added the "Cardano - Unique Submissions" tab to the "Cardano Project Submissions" spreadsheet to make it clear that the total number of submissions across May and June submission rounds was 39. This number is the total sum of projects in "Cardano raw May submissions" and "Cardano raw June submissions" tabs after removing duplicates. The first two tabs were also renamed "June Prize Awardees" and "May pool prize awardees (green=pool prize)" to clarify the people who received prizes in each respective round. 
By Simon Sällström
Project Details
・Project URL on IdeaScale/Fund: https://projectcatalyst.io/funds/13/cardano-open-ecosystem/cardano-x-african-blockchain-championship 
・Project Number: 1300057
・Project Manager: Simon Sällström
・Date Project Started: Jan 20, 2025
・Date Project Completed: Aug 7, 2025

Challenge KPIs & How They Were Addressed
The goal of the Cardano Open: Ecosystem (non-technical) category was to drive grassroots ecosystem growth, foster education and community initiatives, that expand Cardano’s global footprint and onboard more Cardano users. 
Our project addressed this in multiple ways. 
・Development of new content for new developers to start building on Cardano using Aiken. You can see the content Notion page here and the workshop exercise repository here.
・Increased the Cardano blockchain’s global footprint, reaching tens of thousands of people through our marketing and outreach efforts. In particular, Cardano was displayed as a Diamond partner alongside other prominent tier-1 protocols outside the Cardano ecosystem, including Avalanche, zkPass and FLock.io 
・Ignited ecosystem growth by activating developers in-person and remotely across Nigeria, Kenya, Rwanda, Uganda and Ethiopia, resulting in almost a dozen novel projects built on Carda
